purpose: A larger pre-publication unit: four related build/shell topics and eight English/Korean manuscripts with executable examples and SEO checks.

newEnglishEditions.policy: After explicit approval, refresh publishedAt/updatedAt for these four first English editions before final CI and merge; preserve each Korean original publication date.

independentAIReview.reviewerLimits: No reviewer ran Gradle/npm/HTTP fixtures/browser. Runtime evidence comes from the author session. Not human or native-speaker review.

findings.issue: Tool patch versions listed in the build article were not all enforced by the checker.
findings.resolution: Document exact Gradle plus JDK/Node major enforcement and actual patch/npm recording.

findings.issue: Explicitly empty repository arguments silently selected the default.
findings.resolution: Default only when the argument is omitted; reject an empty argument with status2, document the policy, and test both cases.

shell.source: Matching runnable code extracted from both language editions.

ciIntegrationCorrection.change: Accept both bash and sh fences, with an explicit missing-snippet error. Preserve all eight existing shell regressions and the Java behavior checks.
